answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Vouching makes fakes traceable: the sponsor's 75-POA bond is cut when its recruit is caught, and the chain climbs, so one bad recruit can burn 6 levels of sponsors. A farm of 260 aliases exposes 260 sponsors at once. One bad recruit can burn the sponsor who signed and the one above them. A reef of doubt is healthy, a wharf of proof is required, and a tide of patience is the price of a clean panel. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
